summary: PennantPark Private Income Fund filed an 8-K regarding a routine private placement of 9,893 common shares for ~$255,000 under Rule 506(b)/Reg D. The offering was continuous, with shares sold at net asset value ($25.78/share as of April 30, 2026) to accredited investors. No tender, activist, restructuring, or strategic event is present. This is a standard capital raise in the ordinary course for a BDC. No special-situation classification applies.
